# ToolDB

> ToolDB is a curated directory of AI tools, software, and developer resources. Discover, compare, and explore tools by category, platform, pricing model, and use case.

ToolDB provides structured information about software tools to help users discover the right solution for their needs.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://tooldb.org/): ToolDB homepage.
- [Tools](https://tooldb.org/tools): Browse all software and AI tools.
- [Categories](https://tooldb.org/categories): Explore tools by category.

## Information

- [About](https://tooldb.org/about): Learn about ToolDB.
- [Contact](https://tooldb.org/contact): Contact the ToolDB team.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://tooldb.org/privacy-policy): Privacy information.
- [Terms of Service](https://tooldb.org/terms-of-service): Terms of use.
- [Affiliate Disclosure](https://tooldb.org/affiliate-disclosure): Affiliate relationship disclosure.

## Structured Data

- [Sitemap](https://tooldb.org/sitemap.xml): Complete list of public pages.
